releases.notes:
Smooth, fully customizable animations for Minecraft **26.1.2**'s instant GUI — Fabric.

## Features
- **Chat** — new messages slide up smoothly instead of popping in.
- **Item slots** — stacks glide between slots (configurable easing) instead of teleporting.
- **Creative menu** — pixel-smooth scrolling instead of row-paging.
- **Hotbar** — the selector slides between slots.
- **Inventory & pause / menus** — fade & scale on open and close, each with its own style, speed and easing curve.
- **Menu→menu transitions** — **Slide / Zoom / Fade / Swap**, selectable, when navigating between screens (e.g. Pause → Options).
- **Smooth list scrolling** — every vanilla-list screen (Options, Mod Menu, Cloth Config, and any mod that reuses the vanilla list) scrolls eased instead of snapping. No mod is hardcoded.
- **Flat settings screen** — a Sodium-style tabbed GUI (General / Inventory / Game menu / Chat); every knob is live and the screen animates itself.
- A master switch freezes everything back to vanilla.

Vanilla GUIs keep their exact look — only their motion is animated. The mod's own settings screen uses the Limucc flat style.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu (optional, to reach the settings screen)

## Install
Drop `animated-gui-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API.
